name: frontend-workbench
description: Composable guards and workflows for project-fit frontend implementation, dynamic capability and dependency choice, interface copy, calibrated redesign, and visual direction.

interface.shortDescription: Composable workflows for frontend product work
interface.longDescription: An extensible frontend plugin with project-architecture reuse, capability-driven tool and dependency selection, user-facing-copy guards, scope- and intensity-calibrated product redesign, and concept-first visual art direction as composable skills.
defaultPrompt: Use $frontend-project-fit to implement this frontend change by reusing the project's architecture and dynamically choosing the smallest justified tool or dependency.
Use $frontend-copy-guard to audit and fix user-facing UI copy without exposing technical or internal logic.
Use $frontend-product-design to calibrate, research, and justify this UI or UX redesign before implementation.
